name: Jeunesse Eternelle
source:
While walking in the bamboo forest, Kaguya has been taunted by some dumb fairies: they say she was unfashioned!

She absolutely can't stand it!

She then asks Reisen to help her with it, the moon rabbit is going to have a lot to do to satisfy her mistress and avoid Tewi's pranks.

[From [url=https://ezo2.itch.io/eternal-youth]Itch.io[/url]]
